title: Sketch to 3D
author: Amanporwal
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev Built a thing, need your eyes on it 🙏

AI 3D Editor for game devs, 

**3D in 3 Clicks!** No downloads.

Try it: app.vi3w.in

Brutal feedback welcome, it's how we make it better.

Im a solo dev 😁/ ex PM, USP of this product is simplicity & ease of use.

comments.author: Ill-Boysenberry-6821
comments.body:
Asking for sign in without even allowing a demo of the product - shady af.


Farming emails?

replies.author: Amanporwal
replies.body: Yeah, like I can ask them if they wanna buy it in future also a feedback loop to actually build what people need.

replies.author: Ill-Boysenberry-6821
replies.body:
Doesn't work that way. It's straight up suspicious - no one should be signing up unless they know what's even in there


Why should anyone give a random stranger on the internet access to their data?


You need to have guest log in so people can see what's up

replies.author: Amanporwal
replies.body:
Bro im just asking to login, using google im not even asking names or phone numbers. 

Also I cant just keep my app open, that will be a cost for me.

replies.author: Ill-Boysenberry-6821
replies.body:
I'll let someone else take the risk


Will check it out if others confirm it is legit and no hidden scams/shenanigans inside

comments.author: Opening-Bid4424
comments.body: This looks awesome. Would be even better to be able to upload an image (I’m bad at drawing stuff but I usually have a clear picture of what I want / inspirations)

replies.author: Amanporwal
replies.body: Yes you can upload images, there's an option on top right

comments.author: pacchithewizard
comments.body: So whats the backend - Z-Image w/ Controlnet >> Qwen Image Edit >> Trellis 2?

replies.author: Amanporwal
replies.body:
Image to image conversion and image to 3D.

That's it

comments.author: Main-Lifeguard-6739
comments.body: so now i can import this into blender or what ever? or whats the route here? anyways: looks like a very solid workflow!

replies.author: Amanporwal
replies.body: Yes you can import it into blender, unity, unreal or maximo.
